relationships.evidence_quote: The rats treated with the NGF antibody showed a highly significant alleviation of neuropathic pain (NP) symptoms, as evidenced by increased MWT and TWL

relationships.subject: NGF

relationships.subject: ERK
relationships.evidence_quote: These pharmacological dissociations indicate that ERK activation occurs upstream of the histone lysine acetylation change after CCI

relationships.subject: U0126
relationships.evidence_quote: CCI-induced pain was significantly attenuated (Figure 5) and Ac-H3K56 expression was downregulated (Figure 6)

relationships.subject: C646
relationships.evidence_quote: Both U0126 and C646 significantly reduced Ac-H3K56/H3 compared to CCI + vehicle

key_findings: CCI upregulated NGF in the CSF-CN; NGF antibody relieved allodynia/hyperalgesia and reduced p-ERK and Ac-H3K56
ERK inhibition with U0126 reduced pain and Ac-H3K56, defining an NGF/ERK/Ac-H3K56 axis in the CSF-CN
